notes: Occurrence and aggregate annual losses are the same here: one storm per synthetic year (RainyDay keeps each year's largest 3-hour storm).

1 in T: CRC's VaR at q = 1 - 1/T (lower quantile, the extension reports it) and the tools' convention (largest loss with P(L >= x) >= 1/T, as Oasis LMF, OpenQuake and the F4 depth frequency) are shown side by side (design-note question 7).

The main case reads depths below 0.05 m (catalogue.WET_M, the wet rule of the F4 frequency) as 0 before BD-1; read literally (0 m), BD-1 makes about 10,900 buildings wet in every run by sub-millimetre depths: shown as a sensitivity.
Substation values are placeholders [P] (MISO and Con Edison figures, V-1 to V-5); building values are NSI [S] or Hazus substitutes (A-8).
Bor 2026's set is for substations above 345 kV; it is applied to the 138 kV sites as the alternative FR2 names, outside its stated range.
